name: 63361 · Montgomery Cy, MO
findings: ZIP 63361 (Montgomery Cy) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63361 (Montgomery Cy) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 63361 (Montgomery Cy) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 68% of all organizations here have no identified type.
